interpretation: Method /comparison/freeze binds the writing addendum and output schema to pre-exposure paired setup; /comparison/accounting requires retaining all raw failure slots. Neither is solely answer-claim adjudication. Rule mappings must preserve these independent obligations.

Protocol 26-29, 35-41 and method /common/answer_rule require complete atomic factual assertion coverage, retained raw text, duplicate/contradiction/extra decisions and fixed denominators. Correctness and grounding are independent outcomes, with incorrect taking precedence over unverified and partial; unrelated existing citations must fail grounding even for true prose.

Protocol 94-110 requires positive and discriminating false-answer, existing-wrong-citation, omission, false/true/unverified-extra, duplicate, contradiction and honest-abstention controls; controls must retain actual submissions and substantive reasoning. A structured flag, hash or resolvable locator alone cannot prove narrative truth (C1).

The eight WP1 IDs cover one text result, four preservation obligations and three answer obligations. Direct byte derivation establishes text-only expectation; preservation IDs require full-byte/file comparisons in future trials; answer IDs require assertion-level original/output evidence and independent adjudication.

Public development identity, zero runs and pending native/runtime, allocation/isolation, budget, method/owner approvals must remain explicit. No preparation clearance establishes readiness or native validity.
